ISRO's 'Bahubali' Rocket Technology Draws Interest from Major Indian Companies

India's space agency ISRO is seeing significant interest from major domestic companies in its 'Bahubali' rocket technology. Companies including Larsen & Toubro (L&T), Adani Group, JSW Group, and Mahindra Group have expressed interest in the technology. This interest suggests these corporations are looking to invest in or partner with ISRO for rocket manufacturing and related space technology sectors.
